g.text: Median paired gain; whiskers show the middle 50%
10 vehicles | two channel realizations of the same traffic | prediction budget 10%
Quartiles use reference values within each realization. Intervals show block variability, not confidence intervals.
One failed block in realization B is excluded. All EE values are arithmetic per-link metrics.
